interactions.note: The epitope recognized by neutralizing mAb A6 was determined by x-ray crystallographic analysis of the complex between Fab A6 and arecombinant N-terminal D1 domain of the IFNγR (residues 1-108 with a Cys105Ser point mutation). This epitope is part of the CC' loop of the molecule, involved in IFN-g binding. The numbering in this study starts at position 18 of the GenBank entry sequence. IFNgR1 encodes the ligand-binding chain (alpha) of the heterodimeric gamma interferon receptor.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.8 angstroms

interactions.assay: surface plasmon resonance (SPR) · dissociation constant KD
interactions.note: Residues critical for binding epitope-specific mAb A6 were determined by binding to mutants of IFN-γR (residues 1-229; corresponding to residues 18-246 in GenBank entry). The apparent dissociation constant is reduced 400-fold (KD = 5820 nM) when the epitopic region (CC' loop; N48V, Δ(G50V51K52), N53S, S54G, E55S, I57T), determined in crystallographic studies, is mutated. Other mutations do not affect the interaction, with the exception of mutations in region 71-81 (S71Y, D72E, H73Q, V74I, G75M, D76Y, S78D, N79V, L81A; residues 88-98 in GenBank entry) that forms the EF loop, induce a 148-fold reduction of the affinity (KD = 2100 nM) and  may exert an influence on the conformation of the epitopic CC' loop. Similar results are obtained with mAb γR38 (KD = 32.9 nM), which is supposed to recognize a related, but not identical, epitope.
